# SundAI
Less manual work. More room to grow. AI workflows, assistants and cyber services built around your business—with control designed in.

## Services
- [Compliance, GRC & AI Governance](https://sundaibot.com/services/compliance-ai-governance/): Turn regulatory complexity into a clear plan—with risks, owners and evidence your team can actually use.
- [Secure AI Business Automation](https://sundaibot.com/services/secure-ai-automation/): Turn repetitive tasks into secure workflows built around your product, your people and the systems you already use.
- [Private AI Assistants, Agents & RAG](https://sundaibot.com/services/private-ai-agents-rag/): Custom assistants and agents connected to your knowledge—with permission-aware retrieval, scoped tools and auditable actions.
- [OSINT, Pentesting & Red Teaming](https://sundaibot.com/services/pentesting-red-teaming/): Test the attack paths that matter—and leave with findings your team can fix.
- [DevSecOps & Secure Delivery Pipelines](https://sundaibot.com/services/devsecops/): Build security into the path from commit to deployment—with controlled identities, automated checks and releases you can trace.
- [Cloud Security Engineering, Automation & Maintenance](https://sundaibot.com/services/cloud-security/): Get control of identities, privileged access, cloud configuration and security signals—then keep that foundation maintained.

- [Tailored proposals](https://sundaibot.com/pricing/): Scope-based proposals for the company, team and product; core service prices are tailored. A separate one-decision AI Decision Review costs EUR 490 before any applicable VAT.
- [Book](https://sundaibot.com/book/): Free 20-minute call request; awaiting confirmation.
- [Training](https://sundaibot.com/training/): By booking, separate from core services.
- [Network](https://sundaibot.com/join/): Recruitment goals; commission ceiling 12.5%.
- [Evidence and trust](https://sundaibot.com/trust/): Scope, contributor capability and evidence.

- [Shadow AI Assessment](https://sundaibot.com/use-cases/shadow-ai-assessment/)
- [AI Governance Toolkit](https://sundaibot.com/resources/ai-governance-toolkit/)

- [Article 50 AI transparency checklist](https://sundaibot.com/insights/article-50-transparency-checklist.html)

## Practical entry points
- [Free practical PDF guides](https://sundaibot.com/free-guides/): AI Act readiness, agent security and supplier access; optional confirmed three-email series.
- [AI security self-assessment](https://sundaibot.com/ai-security-check/): Four questions with local results before contact capture.
- [AI Decision Review](https://sundaibot.com/ai-decision-review/): EUR 490 for one decision, 45-minute discussion and 3–5-page memo; VAT, scope and timing agreed before acceptance. No checkout or confirmed booking.
- [Client feedback](https://sundaibot.com/customer-scenarios/): Four client testimonials about AI security, decision reviews, literacy training and advisory support.
- [Denmark CPR access lessons](https://sundaibot.com/insights/denmark-cpr-access-security.html): Dated source-based analysis; reported weak passwords are not a proven intrusion method.
